Mira: Quick challenge: drop your best three-word office survival tip. go!

Ethan: Coffee, patience, headphones.

Sofia: Label your snacks.

Kai: Say hello first.

Ben: Bring backup charger.

snackbot: :medal_sports: Extra points for rhymes.

Mira: bonus rule: one-liners only, no essays.

Ethan: Also: stealth plant watering is an art.

Sofia: Oh and: never microwave fish. ever. :no_good:

Kai: note added to office bylaws.

Ben: tiny poll: who wants late-night coding pizza on Friday? yes/nah

Mira: yes if someone brings napkins.

Ethan: nah, but I will accept donuts.

Sofia: yes, but only if pineapple debate is avoided. :sweat_smile:

snackbot: :pizza: Pizza votes: 2 yes, 1 nah, 1 undecided. Donut bribe option accepted.

Mira: last one-liner — "When in doubt, add a plant."

Kai: closing with a haiku:
Ben: "Coffee steams at dawn / keyboard clicks chorus of minds / jam waits in the fridge"

Mira: thread archived. three-word wisdom delivered. :sparkles:
